etsy.title: Kindness Snowman Kit, January Kindness Calendar for Kids, Snowman Arrival Letter and 24 Kindness Notes, After Christmas Elf Alternative
etsy.description:
The elf went home. The kindness doesn't have to. ☃️

The Kindness Snowman Kit keeps your December habit going all through January, when days feel long and kids miss the magic. Each morning your child finds a note from a little snowman with one small, kind mission: help fold the scarves, put out seeds for the winter birds, make a card for someone who feels sick. Read it together, do it together, color one circle. Five minutes a day, no mess, no special doll.

WHAT'S INSIDE (20 pages)
• Snowman arrival letter
• Snowman passport (name it, draw it)
• 24 kindness notes, 4 per page
• Kindness tracker
• 2 lifesaver letters: "I was building snow forts" and "Too warm today!"
• Mid-month "You're doing great" letter
• 4 snow day kindness cards
• Goodbye letter + "I Was Kind!" certificate
• 8 blank notes + 30 more tiny kindness ideas

AGES: 3 to 8. Start any day in January. Works for families, classrooms and siblings.

PAIR IT WITH: Kindness Elf Kit or Kindness Reindeer Kit for December, in our shop.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
